items.name: Mastra Factory
items.description: From issue to production, run by agents.. Mastra Factory is an open source, agent-powered software delivery environment. It combines persistent coding agents, repository workspaces, issue intake, planning, implementation, and pull request review in a web application you control.

raw_data.tagline: From issue to production, run by agents.

items.name: Harden
items.description: A security layer for AI coding agents. Harden AIF is a free, local security tool for AI coding agents. Its post-trained model checks tool calls before they run, using your request and session context. It beat frontier models on key agent-security benchmarks, while keeping your repo and tool output on your machine.

raw_data.tagline: A security layer for AI coding agents

items.name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
items.description: Sharper visuals, faster flow, better creative control. ChatGPT Images 2.5 is OpenAI's next-generation image model built for sharper details, faster generation, and more precise editing. It helps you turn sketches, prompts, and reference photos into polished visuals with better consistency, natural lighting, richer textures, and stronger control across every edit.

raw_data.tagline: Sharper visuals, faster flow, better creative control

items.name: Noodle Seed
items.description: Your product in AI and AI in your product. Noodle Seed helps software teams make their products ready for AI agents. Build workflows in TypeScript, expose them through a secure branded assistant inside your product, and make the same capabilities available to external agents. Instead of stitching together MCP SDKs and hosting infrastructure, Noodle Seed provides the governed runtime for identity, permissions, secrets, audit, and operations.

raw_data.tagline: Your product in AI and AI in your product

items.name: DuckFightClub
items.description: Train your MicroDuck and win the Golden Beak Belt. Imagine WWE SmackDown, but with cute, AI-trained robots. Eight teams spend days training reinforcement-learning policies for Pollen’s open-source MicroDuck, then we throw them in the simulator to fight for the Golden Beak Belt. The whole competition will be livestreamed. The catch: you’re not building a robot, you’re training its brain. Want in? Register a team, train your policy, or host a showdown in your city. When the real MicroDucks ship, we go IRL.

raw_data.tagline: Train your MicroDuck and win the Golden Beak Belt

items.name: AlphaGenome Atlas
items.description: Google's AI map of every possible human DNA mutation. AlphaGenome Atlas is Google DeepMind's AI-powered map of how genetic mutations may affect human biology. Built by precomputing AlphaGenome predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes, the 1-petabyte dataset lets researchers explore and prioritize variants across both coding and non-coding regions. It's free to explore through a visual web interface, with API and Antigravity access for deeper research.

raw_data.tagline: Google's AI map of every possible human DNA mutation

items.name: Type.com
items.description: A shared workspace for Claude, Codex, and your team. Type is a shared workspace that compounds your team's best AI work. Connect tools once, use any model, and put skills, files, and threads in one place your whole team can see. Build custom apps and automations on a company brain that gets smarter as you work.

raw_data.tagline: A shared workspace for Claude, Codex, and your team

items.name: Diiverge
items.description: Turn any picture into a playable AI adventure. Turn a photo, painting or screenshot into a point-and-click adventure. Click something in the scene, choose what happens, and AI creates the next scene and a short film of the moment. Every path is saved, so others can explore the branches you create. Play the public worlds for free, or buy scene packs in the studio to make your own adventure and share it with a link.

raw_data.tagline: Turn any picture into a playable AI adventure

items.name: Frigade Assist API
items.description: Give your AI agent guides that show users where to click. Most in-app AI agents answer "how do I do this?" with a wall of text, because they can't see the screen. The Frigade Assist API is one tool call your existing agent makes. Frigade draws a step-by-step guide right on the page, hands the agent a plain answer when it can't, and tells it what the user is looking at. It knows your product because browser agents used it first, and it relearns every release. Works with the Vercel AI SDK or anything that can call a tool.

raw_data.tagline: Give your AI agent guides that show users where to click

items.name: Pluno
items.description: AI that discovers and runs automations for you. Pluno learns how you work across the browser, understands the steps and decisions you make, and identifies recurring workflows that consume billable time or require paid admin help. It then proposes a clear automation plan and, once approved, runs and manages the automation, without manual workflow mapping, trigger setup, or building.

raw_data.tagline: AI that discovers and runs automations for you

items.name: Nugget — LinkedIn Warm Outreach Tool
items.description: "Your next client is already in your LinkedIn network". You've built a solid LinkedIn network - people who could refer you, hire you, or open a door. But you don't know who's warm, what to say, or where to start. And cold outreach feels too salesy to even try. So you either spray generic messages and pray, or do nothing and leave money on the table. Upload your LinkedIn data once, and Nugget mines it into an actionable plan - who's warm, what to say, and where your next opportunity is hiding. No scraping. No cold outreach. No guessing.

raw_data.tagline: "Your next client is already in your LinkedIn network"

items.name: Moon
items.description: AI Mood Tracker. See what fills your mood and what drains it. Moon is a mood diary for iPhone — and a mood tracker that never gives you advice. Its whole value is in surfacing the factors behind your mood — so you can, in the end, make it better. No account, no sign-up.

raw_data.tagline: AI Mood Tracker. See what fills your mood and what drains it

items.name: CiteGraph
items.description: Get your product mentioned and cited by AI assistants.. AI is recommending your competitors to your buyers right now. CiteGraph asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity your buyers' real questions, shows who gets named instead of you and which pages they cite, and provides you the fixes that wins each answer back. Real answers, error bars, no guesswork.

raw_data.tagline: Get your product mentioned and cited by AI assistants.

items.name: Skeezo
items.description: The macOS IDE that runs your coding agents in parallel. An agent-native macOS IDE for the CLI you already use. Run Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode in parallel lanes that hand off to each other, schedule unattended runs, review diffs, and steer it all from your phone. No API key — it reuses your login.

raw_data.tagline: The macOS IDE that runs your coding agents in parallel

items.name: Milo
items.description: Test your AI support agent before your customers do. Milo gives your AI email agent fake customers with real email addresses. Six scripted personas (angry refunds, chargeback threats, silence, GDPR requests) reply over real SMTP, deterministically: same inputs, same replies, no LLM in the reply path. Plus-address run IDs and a JSON lookup API make every conversation assertable in CI. There is no signup: emailing refund-angry@joinmilo.email is the onboarding. Strict mode rebuffs vague promises. MCP server, llms.txt and an agent skill included.

raw_data.tagline: Test your AI support agent before your customers do

items.description: Stage rooms & turn listing photos into videos. No prompts.. Turn property photos into staged interiors, polished listing images, and narrated tour videos. 1. Upload your photos, 2. choose a style or correction, and 3. generate without writing prompts. items.name: UI-Atlas
items.description: Map desktop interfaces for computer-use agents. UI-Atlas is an open-source, offline-first toolkit for building evidence-backed maps of desktop interfaces. It captures surfaces, controls, states, actions, transitions, and lineage to observed evidence. The maps can support agents, testing, accessibility, automation, and security or governance systems that need to understand what is being acted on. UI-Atlas maps the interface; it does not enforce policy or execute workflows.

raw_data.tagline: Map desktop interfaces for computer-use agents

items.description: Compare AI opinions. See where they agree and disagree.. Ask one question and get independent perspectives from multiple AI models, followed by a clear recommendation. Council shows agreements, disagreements, a consensus score, and each advisor's reasoning. Choose your models and continue with follow-up questions. Available on iPhone, iPad, and the web.

raw_data.tagline: Compare AI opinions. See where they agree and disagree.

items.name: Heimdall
items.description: AI writes the code. Heimdall maps what it built.. AI writes the code. Heimdall helps you understand the system. Turn any codebase into an interactive architecture map. Explore dependencies, modules, and relationships across 16 languages. Entirely on your machine, with your source code staying private. Use Heimdall to understand unfamiliar codebases, navigate complex systems, and see what AI-generated code is actually building.

raw_data.tagline: AI writes the code. Heimdall maps what it built.

items.name: Kivara AI
items.description: Interactive AI roleplay & stories with persistent memory. Kivara AI is an immersive storytelling & roleplay platform designed to solve AI context loss. Powered by a hybrid pgvector RAG memory pipeline, characters truly remember ongoing plots, character traits, and world events. Features: • Persistent long-term memory & continuity summaries • Multi-agent group chats & branching dialogue forks • Context-aware scene image generation • Telegram Mini App integration & multi-language support (EN, RU, UA, DE, JA)

raw_data.tagline: Interactive AI roleplay & stories with persistent memory

items.name: Hot Desk
items.description: Local Linux desktops for AI agents, with human takeover. Hot Desk gives each AI agent its own local Linux desktop. The home directory and Chromium profile persist, so a site you sign into once stays signed in for later sessions. Your agent connects over MCP and receives the browser, computer and workspace tools directly, with no tokens and no model API key in the config. When it gets stuck on a login or a CAPTCHA, you open the viewer, take over the same desktop, then hand control back. Runs on Docker on your own machine. MIT licensed.
